newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Globe and Mail endorses Conservatives.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Globe and Mail endorses Conservatives.

text.p: Canada's influential daily newspaper, the Globe and Mail, on Thursday endorsed Jean Charest's Conservative party in the Canadian federal election next Monday.
The Toronto-based paper rejected Prime Minister Jean Chretien's Liberals as lacking in vision.

"As a political leader, Jean Charest is clearly superior to Jean Chretien...the fact that Mr. Charest's teammates are largely unknown and untested is a liability, but less so than Mr. Chretien's presumptuous absence of policy or vision," the Globe said in an editorial.

The Liberals lead in opinion polls ahead of the June 2 vote, with the support of about 40 percent of decided voters, versus 22 percent for the Conservatives and 18 percent for the right-wing Reform party.
Canada's largest newspaper, the Toronto Star, has endorsed the Liberals.
